evidence.C1: "the tank is drawn as a glass box" and species-specific fish forms make it pleasant, but side cards and garden/focus screens still feel like generic floating cards.
evidence.C2: "Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes." plus labelled tools make actions findable, though phone tool grids and fishing fight controls are dense.
evidence.C3: "Breeding with inherited colours; aquascaping... greenhouse trays... reef lab... orders, journal, focus" clearly exceeds a typical cozy aquarium, but interlocking is mostly described rather than shown.
evidence.C4: "floating white cards with layered shadows" gives consistency, but the garden toast and some small/cut-off helper text need tidier placement.

fixes: Make the next step unmistakable on dense screens: group phone tools and fishing fight controls, and surface one primary action per screen.
Push the field-guide visual identity beyond generic cards: give side panels, garden trays, and focus stats more distinctive aquarium/field-guide treatment.
Show the loops interlocking in the UI: connect water quality, fishing catches, cuttings, breeding, orders, and journal progress with visible cause-and-effect feedback.

evidence.C1: Tank environment is well-crafted with perspective glass box, depth haze, receding gravel, back-glass silhouettes, but the fish themselves read as simple flat shapes ('fish floor shadows' present but bodies lack the detail of the environment); palette is coherent warm cream + green, journal silhouettes add field-guide feel.
evidence.C2: 'More to do' section explicitly guides new players to fishing/greenhouse/journal; tools row clearly labeled (Feed, Care, Scape, Residents, Shop, Photo, Watch, Share); phone layout groups 8 tools in 2 rows of 4 with bottom nav; fishing controls (Flick/Classic, Phone motion/Vibration, Bait) are well organized.
evidence.C3: All listed loops present: nitrogen-cycle care, 9-spot fishing minigame with reel/tension, breeding with inherited colors, aquascaping (16 plants/8 hardscape/3 substrates/3 tank sizes), greenhouse with variegated sports, reef lab with named strains, journal dex with 47 species, focus timer, daily orders, streaks, offline catch-up.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating nav, card shadows across screens; however the 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more' toast on the Garden screen overlaps the top nav area, and the focus screen's '0 min this week · 0 min focused in total' sits in an empty bar with no visual fill state.

fixes: Increase detail and distinctiveness of the in-tank fish illustrations (fins, scales, eye, body shading) so they match the quality of the tank environment and the journal silhouettes.
Reposition or restyle the unlock notification so it does not overlap the top nav on the Garden screen (e.g., slide in below the nav or use an inline banner).

Replace the plain 'Not found yet' journal cards with partial silhouettes, environmental hints, or rarity-colored outlines so the dex actively teases discovery instead of looking like empty placeholders.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette and serif/sans pairing; tank is the hero with 'perspective side panes, receding gravel floor, depth haze, back-glass planting silhouettes, fish floor shadows' and per-species forms; journal silhouettes with 'Paracheirodon innesi' give a field-guide feel — but fishing/garden screens are plainer, so not 'every screen feels designed'.
evidence.C2: Explicit next-step guidance on every screen: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', 'Line is slack. Reel', 'How the greenhouse works' steps 1-4; labelled 8-tool row; phone layouts uncramped. Only minor gains left (e.g. tool row lacks care/manage grouping).
evidence.C3: Summary claims every anchor loop: nitrogen-cycle care, flick/reel fishing with 'drag settings' and 'tournaments against CPU anglers with hot-seat', 'Breeding with inherited colours', reef lab 'frag, cross, named strains', greenhouse, orders, journal, focus; screenshots confirm care/fishing/garden/journal/focus, but breeding, reef genetics and scaping loops are not evidenced visually, so 'clearly exceed' is not fully demonstrated.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards, floating nav, toasts ('Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more') and 'fine' status dots; rough edges remain: the phone onboarding hint is a large dark block covering the tank centre, the care modal's last row has one orphan tile, and the desktop fishing screen's lower-left is empty.

fixes: Lift secondary screens to the tank's craft standard: resolve the desktop fishing screen's empty lower-left, enrich the sparse garden tray art, and push the field-guide character beyond the journal so every screen feels designed (C1, largest weighted gap).
Pixel-tidy pass: shrink or auto-dismiss the phone onboarding hint so it stops covering the tank, even out the care modal tile grid, and balance the desktop fishing columns (C4).

Make the hidden depth visible: add discoverable entry points or teasers for breeding, the reef lab and scaping on the tank/journal screens so the interlocking loops are evident in the UI rather than only in the summary (C3).
